title: Climate Resilience
transcript: Moderator: We are reviewing the resilience plan. Councilmember: We will release a dashboard that tracks stormwater permits and mobilize transit ridership data every Friday. Engineer: The working group already opened two new shelters for rainy-season response.

title: Healthcare Briefing
transcript: Reporter: Will the new clinic hours impact staff schedules? Administrator: Hours extend by two evenings once we secure the additional grant, but the logistics team needs a final staffing memo. EMT: We are coordinating with the grant team to share patient trends before the next council vote.
